title: Local 2026 Advertising: +24% On Big Political Gains

facts.fact: MediaPost's article headline states that local 2026 advertising is up 24%, driven by big political gains.
facts.quote: Local 2026 Advertising: +24% On Big Political Gains

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services estimates that core local TV ad spend excluding political, across over-the-air, local CTV, and cable, will dip 1% to $19.4 billion.
facts.quote: Core local TV advertising spend, excluding political, of all types -- over the air, local CTV, and cable -- is expected to dip 1% to $19.4 billion

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services estimates that local cable ad spend will drop 9% to $2.0 billion.
facts.quote: Local cable ad spend will also drop -- 9% to $2.0 billion.

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services estimates local connected TV (CTV) ad spend, excluding political, at $3.6 billion, 9% higher than in 2025.
facts.quote: The only growth will be seen in connected TV (CTV) -- at $3.6 billion, 9% higher than in 2025.

facts.fact: Including political ad spend, BIA Advisory Services estimates local CTV ad spend will jump nearly 35% to $4.6 billion.
facts.quote: Adding in political ad spend, CTV will jump by nearly 35% next year to $4.6 billion.

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services states local CTV will command a nearly 19% share of local TV ad spend, per the page's wording referencing 2025.
facts.quote: That means CTV will command a nearly 19% share of local TV ad spend from 2025.

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services estimates over-the-air TV will remain the largest share of local TV ad spend at $17.7 billion, a 69% share.
facts.quote: The biggest share still goes to over-the-air TV, landing at $17.7 billion -- a 69% share.

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services estimates local TV ad spend will rise 24% next year, mostly due to the mid-term political season, up from $14.3 billion the previous year.
facts.quote: TV will climb 24% next year, mostly due to the mid-term political advertising season from $14.3 billion the previous year.

facts.fact: Including political advertising, BIA Advisory Services estimates overall local TV ad spend (over the air, CTV, and cable) will climb 24% to $24.7 billion.
facts.quote: Overall local TV ad spend (over the air, CTV, and cable) when including political advertising -- will climb 24% to $24.7 billion.

facts.fact: BIA Advisory Services estimates the political advertising boost to local TV spend at $5.3 billion, roughly the same as estimates for the 2024 Presidential political year.
facts.quote: Th overall boost from political advertising is expected to be $5.3 billion, roughly the same according to estimates for the 2024 Presidential political year.

facts.fact: Of the political advertising boost to local TV, BIA projects $1 billion will go to CTV.
facts.quote: One billion dollars is projected to go for CTV.
